decision.reason: [ev-dac056af4ac4] is just a prerequisite bullet in the upgrade guide. It says "You're not using deprecated features" and links to a "removed features" section that is not included in the evidence. It does not say which feature, API or field changed, how it changed, who is exposed, or what happens if an operator does nothing. The excerpts from the linked Removed features section are needed, and they should probably be split into one change per removed feature.
